messages.subject: multilevel moderated mediation(2-1-1 with a level 1 moderator in the second stage)
parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to do a 2-1-1 moderated mediation analysis. independent variable(team leadership, level 2), mediator(individual psychologal safety, level 1), outcome variable(individual voice, level1), and the moderator(leader-member exchange, level 1) moderates the relationship between psychological safety and voice. However, I found no relevant resource in R.  The problem is that I don't know how to test the moderated mediation hypothesis. 
Could you please tell me how to construt the MSEM to test the model?
Best,
ping

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: multilevel moderated mediation(2-1-1 with a level 1 moderator in the second stage)
parts: I'm trying to do a 2-1-1 moderated mediation analysis

This is problematic in lavaan because there is no way to calculate product terms between the latent within-level or between-level components.  You can do the decomposition yourself (manifest approach): calculate cluster means (between component), then calculate cluster-mean-centered data (within component), and calculate the product terms to model moderating effects.  In your model syntax, only include the respective components in their appropriate level-specific models.
